references.text: Balaam previously went off to seek omens, but here he changes his practice.
Previous instance where Balaam went off to meet the Lord.
God had already commanded Balaam to bless Israel, not curse them.
Balak complains that Balaam is blessing Israel instead of cursing them.
Balaam acknowledges that he has been commanded to bless and cannot reverse it.
Divination and sorcery are forbidden in Israel, as Balaam previously practiced.
Reference to the divination practice (נחש) that Balaam previously sought.
Prohibition against divination in the Mosaic Law.
